fusions.name: Steady Hold
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Catch and Pass
fusions.desc: A swing that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on a struck enemy spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Take Up Arms
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Sure Grip
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
